maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from gaming, food, beverage and hotel guests at its Nevada casinos and taverns, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers gambling, dining and staying at its casinos and taverns; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Acquired casinos and taverns over time, but now mostly operates its seven casinos and 74 taverns, and has sold some assets.

mission_critical.reason: Casino and tavern patrons are discretionary consumers who can easily switch to competing venues; loyalty rewards are a weak lock-in.
